steps.reasoning: All required public API signatures must be inspected before any task API is called.
steps.action_code:
required_api_refs = [
    ("supervisor", "show_profile"),
    ("supervisor", "show_account_passwords"),
    ("supervisor", "complete_task"),
    ("spotify", "login"),
    ("spotify", "show_song_library"),
    ("spotify", "show_playlist_library"),
    ("spotify", "show_playlist"),
    ("spotify", "show_song"),
    ("spotify", "remove_song_from_library"),
    ("spotify", "remove_song_from_playlist"),
]
api_documentation = {}
for app_name, api_name in required_api_refs:
    api_documentation[(app_name, api_name)] = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name=app_name, api_name=api_name)

steps.reasoning: The documented Supervisor APIs provide the account email and Spotify password needed to obtain an access token without hardcoding or printing credentials.

spotify_access_token = spotify_session["access_token"]
